jurisdiction.name: Trinidad & Tobago
jurisdiction.constitutionalFoundation: Constitution of Trinidad and Tobago (Republic, 1976). Final appellate court: Caribbean Court of Justice (CCJ); Privy Council remains an option for pre-2010 matters.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the subdivision of land into parcels to be owned individually and the remainder to be owned in common, and for related matters.
primaryActs.summary: Establishes the strata/condominium model in Trinidad & Tobago: unit ownership, common property, management corporations, insurance, and sinking funds. Section 26 governs meetings; S.27 the insurance trust.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the adjudication of claims to ownership of land and the registration of title.
primaryActs.summary: Replaced the old 1960s cadastral system. Provides for adjudication of ownership disputes, registered title, and the recording of prescriptive claims. Sections 35–37 deal with adverse possession.

primaryActs.shortTitle: Registration of Titles to Land Act
primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to make provision for the registration of title to land in Trinidad and Tobago.
primaryActs.summary: Companion to the Land Adjudication Act. Section 22 establishes the priority of registered interests; section 32 deals with fraud and compensation.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to make provision for the settlement of trade disputes.
primaryActs.summary: Establishes the Industrial Court and the procedures for labour disputes. Tenancy relevance: where commercial leases contain enforcement covenants, this Act governs any labour-related disruption.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to make provision for the restriction of rent of certain dwelling-houses.
primaryActs.summary: Caps residential rent for pre-1998 tenancies. Caps also apply to service charges. Section 8 sets the dispute path via the Rent Assessment Board.

regulations.title: Condominium Regulations
regulations.summary: Form of by-laws, insurance trust, sinking-fund contributions.

leadingCases.caseName: Wright v Ocean View Condominium Corp.
leadingCases.court: Court of Appeal of Trinidad and Tobago
leadingCases.headnote: Quorum requirements in s.26 of the Condominium Act apply to budget votes; absence of a quorum invalidates the special assessment.

proceduralRules.title: Industrial Court Rules
proceduralRules.summary: Procedure for the Industrial Court including tenancy-related matters.

remedies.label: Strata-Corporation Special Assessment Challenge
remedies.description: Quorum+notice challenge to a special assessment under the Condominium Act 2006 s.26.
remedies.applicableWhere: TT condominium developments — special assessments > 10% of unit value
